items.description: Adds the `thor-repo` commands `list`, `scan`, and `add`, which print the repos selected from `~/.config/repos.yaml` by tag or stack, report each entry whose stack differs from what its clone's tracked files signal, and print the entry that registers a clone, writing to the registry only under `--write`. (#528)
Renames the unreleased `repos` package to `@williamthorsen/repo-tools` and its binary from `repos` to `thor-repo`, without changing what the scaffolded binary does. (#523)
